change.before: "changing device MTU required restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU"
change.after: "MTU auto-detection is continuous during agent lifetime"

exposure.needed: whether the agent relies on MTU auto-detection (rather than an explicitly configured MTU) and whether the device MTU actually changes during the agent's lifetime

consequence.statement: The agent still works, but MTU handling differs: a changed device MTU is now picked up without restarting the agent, so environments that changed device MTUs and relied on restart-time pickup (or expected the agent to keep the MTU detected at startup) will see the new continuous behavior.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; verify that continuous pickup of device MTU changes is acceptable if device MTUs change while the agent runs.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0, MTU auto-detection runs continuously during the cilium agent's lifetime, so changing a device's MTU no longer requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU.
